name: Business Intelligence & Analytics Platforms
description: Monitoring the BI-tooling and modern-data-stack layer — Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Qlik, Airflow/dbt, Fivetran/Airbyte, data quality & observability, catalog/lineage/governance, semantic layers, and reverse ETL. Extract/refresh SLAs, pipeline failures, data freshness, capacity/cost, adoption, and access audit for the platforms that produce the numbers the business trusts.
quickTip: Most BI and data-stack tools expose admin/audit logs, REST admin APIs, and repository databases — ingest them via HEC, scripted REST inputs, or Splunk DB Connect and correlate refresh, pipeline, and usage signals in one place.

subcategories.name: Tableau
subcategories.primaryAppTa: Splunk DB Connect (Splunkbase 2686) against the Tableau Server repository (PostgreSQL `workgroup` DB), Tableau Server `backgrounder`/`vizqlserver`/`dataserver` logs via Universal Forwarder, Tableau Server REST/Metadata API and Tableau Server Manager (TSM) metrics via HEC scripted inputs.
subcategories.dataSources: Tableau Server logs (`tableau:backgrounder`, `tableau:vizqlserver`, `tableau:httpd`), `workgroup` repository tables (`background_jobs`, `http_requests`, `_views_stats`, `licensing`) via DB Connect, TSM/Resource Monitoring Tool metrics, Tableau Cloud Admin Insights and Activity Log exports.

subcategories.name: Microsoft Power BI
subcategories.primaryAppTa: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services / Microsoft 365 (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`) for the Power BI activity log via the Office 365 Management Activity API, Power BI REST Admin API via HEC scripted inputs, on-premises data gateway logs via Universal Forwarder.
subcategories.dataSources: Power BI activity events (`o365:management:activity` with `Workload=PowerBI`), Power BI REST Admin API (`/admin/groups`, `/datasets/refreshes`, capacities `/capacities/refreshables`), on-prem data gateway `Mashup`/`GatewayInfo` logs, Premium capacity metrics.

subcategories.name: Google Looker & Looker Studio
subcategories.primaryAppTa: Looker System Activity via the Looker API (i__looker internal model) and Admin API through HEC scripted inputs; Looker Studio usage via the Google Workspace/Cloud audit logs (`Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform`).
subcategories.dataSources: Looker System Activity (`history`, `pdt_builds`, `scheduled_plan`, `event`, `api_usage`), Looker API queue/PDT build metrics, GCP audit logs for Looker Studio and BigQuery-backed reports.

subcategories.name: Qlik
subcategories.primaryAppTa: Qlik Sense Enterprise logs (Scheduler/Engine/Proxy/Repository) via Universal Forwarder; Qlik Cloud events via the Qlik Cloud REST API through HEC scripted inputs.
subcategories.dataSources: Qlik Sense logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), reload task history, section access audit, Qlik Cloud events (`com.qlik.v1.*`) and app/reload metrics via REST.

subcategories.name: Open-Source & Embedded BI
subcategories.primaryAppTa: Apache Superset / Metabase / Redash application logs via Universal Forwarder or container stdout; Celery worker metrics and app repository databases via Splunk DB Connect; Sigma/Mode audit-log exports via HEC.
subcategories.dataSources: Superset logs (`superset:app`, Celery worker/beat), Metabase logs (`metabase:app`), Redash query logs, application repository tables (query cache, dashboard views), embedding/SDK error events via HEC.

subcategories.name: Other Enterprise BI
subcategories.primaryAppTa: MicroStrategy Intelligence Server / IBM Cognos / SAP BusinessObjects / Oracle Analytics / ThoughtSpot / Amazon QuickSight logs via Universal Forwarder, vendor admin APIs, and cloud provider TAs (`Splunk_TA_aws` for QuickSight CloudTrail/CloudWatch).
subcategories.dataSources: MicroStrategy DSSErrors/statistics, Cognos audit database via DB Connect, BusinessObjects Auditing/CMS logs, Oracle Analytics usage tracking, ThoughtSpot audit logs, QuickSight CloudTrail and SPICE-capacity CloudWatch metrics.

subcategories.name: Data Orchestration & Transformation
subcategories.primaryAppTa: Apache Airflow scheduler/worker logs and StatsD metrics via HEC; dbt run-results/manifest artifacts and dbt Cloud API via HEC scripted inputs; Dagster/Prefect event logs; Control-M via its TA.
subcategories.dataSources: Airflow logs (`airflow:scheduler`, `airflow:task`), Airflow StatsD/OTel metrics, dbt `run_results.json` / `sources.json` artifacts (`dbt:run_results`), dbt Cloud API run history, Dagster/Prefect run events.

subcategories.name: Data Ingestion & ELT
subcategories.primaryAppTa: Fivetran / Airbyte / Stitch / Matillion logs and REST APIs via HEC scripted inputs; Kafka Connect JMX/REST; cloud ELT via `Splunk_TA_aws` (Glue) and `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices` (Azure Data Factory).
subcategories.dataSources: Fivetran log service events and Metadata/REST API (`connectors`, `sync` status), Airbyte job logs (`airbyte:job`), Matillion task history, Kafka Connect connector/task status, AWS Glue job runs (CloudWatch), ADF pipeline runs (Azure Monitor).

subcategories.name: Data Quality & Observability
subcategories.primaryAppTa: Monte Carlo / Bigeye / Soda webhooks and REST APIs via HEC; Great Expectations validation results and dbt test results via HEC scripted inputs; custom SQL data-quality probes via Splunk DB Connect.
subcategories.dataSources: Monte Carlo incident webhooks (`montecarlo:incident`), Great Expectations `validation_result` JSON (`great_expectations:validation`), Soda scan results, dbt test failures, warehouse `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` freshness/volume probes via DB Connect.

subcategories.name: Data Catalog, Lineage & Governance
subcategories.primaryAppTa: Collibra / Alation / Atlan / DataHub / Microsoft Purview / Databricks Unity Catalog audit logs and REST APIs via HEC scripted inputs; OpenLineage/Marquez events via HEC.
subcategories.dataSources: Catalog audit events (`collibra:audit`, `atlan:audit`, `datahub:audit`), OpenLineage run events (`openlineage:event`), Unity Catalog audit logs, Purview scan/classification results, stewardship and access-policy change events.

subcategories.name: Semantic & Metrics Layer
subcategories.primaryAppTa: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow and Cube query logs and APIs via HEC scripted inputs; AtScale engine logs; LookML content-validator output.
subcategories.dataSources: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow query logs, Cube API request logs and pre-aggregation build metrics (`cube:api`), AtScale engine query logs, LookML validation and metric-definition change events.

subcategories.name: Reverse ETL & Activation
subcategories.primaryAppTa: Hightouch / Census sync webhooks and REST APIs via HEC; Segment/RudderStack delivery events via HEC scripted inputs.
subcategories.dataSources: Hightouch sync run events (`hightouch:sync`), Census sync history (`census:sync`), Segment/RudderStack destination delivery and error events, audience-refresh latency metrics via REST.

subcategories.name: BI & Analytics-Platform Trending
subcategories.primaryAppTa: Cross-platform rollups over the indexes populated by the other cat-24 subcategories; Splunk ITSI (Splunkbase 1841) for service-level trending where available.
subcategories.dataSources: Aggregated cat-24 indexes (BI usage, refresh/pipeline outcomes, data-quality incidents, cost/capacity metrics) summarised via `tstats`, `stats`, and summary indexing for adoption, SLA, and spend trends.
